reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the sachets: pocket-sized and tear open with one hand, so I can toss them in my tote and stop leaving my pills at home on work trips. It costs double what I usually pay, so I would try one box, not subscribe.
objection: $29.99 is about double what I paid for a bottle that lasts 3 months, so I am paying a lot for the packaging and the lab report.
would_change_my_mind: A price closer to $20 to $22 a box, or a smaller trial pack so I can test it on a couple of trips first.
